name: check
wording: A deterministic test: an example's check, a contract, or one of the project's own tests. Every check runs on every change before it joins, and no change joins unless all of them pass. A check the check-writer writes for an example is written before the build and trusted only once seen to fail against work that does not satisfy it; an example with no cheap and repeatable check is judged in review.
reason: The operator: what cratylus delivers assumed one convention, GitHub flow with a branch and a pull request per task, and review of every change whatever its risk; it is generic over a project's conventions, and review follows risk as Ship, Show or Ask.
